name: BuiltOS
long_description: Built OS, formerly WeReno, turns drawings, BIM, site data, and property workflows into intelligent systems that help teams understand, operate, and improve buildings. Our products support the full building lifecycle, from creating AI-powered 3D twins and managing maintenance and repairs to coordinating operations, planning renovations, bidding work, and forecasting CapEx. Today, buildings are still run through PDFs, spreadsheets, emails, site walks, and disconnected vendors; Built OS brings those workflows into one connected AI platform.
one_liner: Built OS is the AI operating system for buildings.
